title: Crypto scam mastermind gets 20 years for $73M pig butchering scheme
summary: A US court sentenced Daren Li to 20 years in prison for leading a $73 million crypto pig butchering scam targeting American investors.

title: Gemini exit a ‘blow for policymakers’ with UK crypto hub ambitions
summary: Industry groups and exchanges said the United Kingdom’s slow, overlapping crypto rules and compliance frictions are undermining its “global hub” ambition.

title: Bitcoin ETFs extend rebound as $145M in fresh inflows hit market
summary: The Bitcoin ETF rebound comes as analysts flag slowing outflows. Early BTC holders trim positions rather than exit as BTC hovers near $70,000, according to Bitwise.

title: Analysts debate whether Ether has capitulated or has further to fall
summary: Analysts say Ether’s MVRV Z-Score has entered capitulation territory at -0.42 after falling 30% in a fortnight, though it is still far from its worst score.

title: Fed’s Waller says crypto hype ‘fading’ with TradFi tie-ins
summary: The crypto market’s volatility is just “part of the game,” says Federal Reserve governor Chris Waller, who adds that traditional finance may have added to the recent market drop.

title: Chainlink co-founder’s 2 reasons this bear market feels different
summary: Chainlink co-founder Sergey Nazarov says the recent crypto market downturn has inadvertently shown “how far the industry has progressed.”

title: Ethereum Foundation teams up with SEAL to combat wallet drainers
summary: SEAL and the Ethereum Foundation created a Trillion Dollar Security dashboard to track Ethereum security as part of efforts to fight wallet drainers.

title: Crypto exchange Backpack to launch token with unlocks tied to IPO goal
summary: Backpack founder Armani Ferrante says the company’s staff and investors won’t get an allocation at its upcoming token launch to avoid insiders “dumping on retail.”

title: Vitalik Buterin details how Ethereum could work alongside AI
summary: The Ethereum co-founder sees crypto providing privacy rails, verification systems and economic layers to help decentralize AI and benefit society.

title: ‘No privacy’ CBDCs will come, warns billionaire Ray Dalio
summary: Hedge fund manager Ray Dalio warns that CBDCs will eliminate financial privacy and enable governments to tax, seize funds and cut off political opponents.
